`meddocan_icd10.json` maps each of the 250 MEDDOCAN documents used here to its ICD-10 diagnosis codes and ICD-10
chapters. The codes come from the CodiEsp corpus (diagnosis subtask), which annotates the same SPACCC clinical case
reports: Miranda-Escalada, Gonzalez-Agirre, Armengol-Estapé and Krallinger (2020), *Overview of automatic clinical
coding: annotations, guidelines, and solutions for non-English clinical cases at CodiEsp track of CLEF eHealth 2020*,
CEUR Workshop Proceedings 2696. The corpus is distributed under CC BY 4.0 (https://zenodo.org/records/3837305).
